newsitem.title: USA: BBDO Canada wins four OBIE awards.
newsitem.headline: BBDO Canada wins four OBIE awards.

text.p: BBDO Canada came away with four awards, including a Best of Show for a Federal Express campaign, at the annual OBIE awards presentation Thursday night by the Outdoor Advertising Association of America.

The Canadian shop, a unit of Omnicom's BBDO Worldwide, won Best of Show for a campaign that played off standard shipping and handling instructions. Headlines included "Do Not Damage...Your Reputation," and "Avoid Excessive Heat...From Your Boss."

Other Best of Show awards went to LOIS/EJL, Los Angeles, for an innovative combination billboard and radio campaign for the Beverly Center, and J. Walter Thompson, San Francisco, for use of black and white urban scenes in a campaign for the San Francisco AIDS Foundation.
OAAA said the Coca-Cola Co. was inducted into the group's Hall of Fame "for its indelible mark on the outdoor advertising medium since the company's first national poster campaign in 1925."

The association represents more than 600 individual out-of-home advertising companies wordwide. The OBIE award derived its name from the first form of outdoor advertising -- the Egyptian obelisk, a tall stone structure used to publicize laws and treaties.
